purpose: New fixed descriptive stat-forecast cohort, separate from the earlier Maye/Mahomes/Kelce/Smith-Njigba audit. Not a betting backtest or live-policy replay.
specification: 2024 warm-up; 2025 regular-season prequential evaluation with strictly earlier completed appearances only. Fixed trailing maximum 20, minimum 8. Compare trailing stat mean, existing 60/40 workload times 40/60 efficiency model, and SHADOW 60/40 pooled opportunity-share times 60/40 team-volume times the same efficiency. No coefficient search. All three compared on the identical complete-source training/target cohort; separately report every excluded target and source failure. Target actual comes from game log; target-game team opportunity is never an input to its prediction. Player/category ID, opponent, final status, opportunity totals and observed stats must reconcile for training rows.
restrictions: Current injury/roster data must not enter historical predictors. Retrieved box scores are revised, not pregame archives. Cohort is illustrative, not league-representative. Source gaps are exclusions, not zero values. Multiple props from one game are correlated. Do not aggregate yards and receptions into one MAE. No odds purchase, win/loss, EV, ROI, calibration claim or automatic model promotion. Report all results even if the candidate loses. Future 2026 paper evaluation remains necessary.
